description: Neighbour-led mutual aid for unhoused residents; the founding year is given as 2017 on the campaign biography page's narrative and is recorded at year precision only.
Elected in November 2020; the campaign says 2,000 volunteers knocked on more than 80,000 doors and that she was the first to defeat a sitting councilmember in 17 years.
Won re-election in the 2022 cycle; LAist's candidate guide is the corroborating source.
